scope: First-entry journey preparation, static geometry batching, and complete project-town arrival
method: Visible development diagnostics collect render-start to after-render CPU time, frame-start gaps, peak draw calls and PerformanceObserver long tasks during an eight-second page sample. These are uncontrolled local samples, not GPU timings, an old-M1 benchmark, or a comprehensive full-world profile. The home repeat used a freshly reloaded page; driver and browser caches can remain warm. No build or source edits ran during active captures.
changes: Selected home starts mounting before proximity is reached. PreparedGroup calls the renderer's compileAsync against the persistent world scene and reveals its existing group after preparation; it invalidates the demand renderer even when motion is paused.

Workshop facade slats and bench slats are merged per material with the same rounded geometry, UVs and normals. No triangle-detail reduction. Orbit sample draw calls fell from 816 to 672 and uploaded geometry count from 461 to 389; triangle count remained 551k.

Project exhibits remain enabled whenever Project Town is selected. Previous desktop arrival stopped just outside the distance threshold and showed empty plinths. The corrected populated arrival costs more than the old incomplete one: steady 613 calls/694k triangles versus 342 calls/320k in the first post-batching sample.
